# DevInvicta

> AI-focused software house based in Porto, Portugal. We build AI agents, web platforms, and mobile apps for ambitious teams — with responsible AI and EU AI Act compliance built in.

## What We Do

DevInvicta engineers custom software at the intersection of AI and product. We work with companies that want to embed AI into the heart of their operations, not just as a feature, but as a core competitive advantage.

We deliver:

- **AI Agents & LLMs** — Custom AI agent pipelines, LLM integrations, RAG systems, and intelligent automation.
- **Web Development** — Full-stack platforms, SaaS products, and performance-first web applications.
- **Mobile Apps** — Cross-platform and native mobile applications (iOS & Android).
- **UX/UI Design** — User-centred design systems, prototyping, and product design.
- **AI Automation & Workflows** — Business process automation with AI orchestration.
- **Cloud & Backend** — Scalable backend services, DevOps, infrastructure, and API design.

## How We Work

We are transparent and phased — clients pay as they see results. Every engagement starts with a free diagnostic session, followed by a clear, phased proposal with investments defined upfront.

We practice **responsible AI by default**: EU AI Act compliant, GDPR-aware, and production-tested before handoff.

## Who We Work With

We partner with:
- Startups scaling their MVP to production
- Scale-ups integrating AI into existing operations
- Enterprises automating internal processes with custom AI agents

## Notable Work

- **EuropaColon** — Patient digital platform for oncology support (web + mobile)
- **Vmoove** — Transport marketplace with AI-powered logistics
- **Fintech AI pipeline** — Automated 80% of support ticket handling in 3 weeks
- **Insurance SaaS** — AI-driven document processing and fraud detection
